name: contrast-picker
title: Contrast Picker
description: Pick two colors from anywhere on screen, check WCAG 2.2 and APCA contrast, and copy an accessible fix in one keystroke.
author: omegaskiller

commands.name: pick-and-check
commands.title: Pick & Check Contrast
commands.subtitle: Contrast Picker
commands.description: Pick the text color, then the background color, and see the contrast result with fixes.

commands.name: check-contrast
commands.title: Check Contrast
commands.subtitle: Contrast Picker
commands.description: Check the contrast of two colors. Prefills from your last two copied colors.

preferences.name: fixTarget
preferences.title: Primary Fix Target
preferences.description: The standard that the main suggested fix must pass.

preferences.name: copyFormat
preferences.title: Primary Copy Format
preferences.description: The format used when you press Return to copy the suggested fix.

preferences.name: useClipboard
preferences.label: Prefill from clipboard
preferences.description: When Check Contrast opens without colors, use the last two copied colors.
